classification.difficultyReason: Represent bounce heights as repeated factors of 0.8, compare them with 0.1 of the original and establish the first whole bounce below the threshold.

content.prompt:
A ball is dropped. After each bounce, it reaches a height that is 80% of its previous maximum.
After how many bounces would it reach a height that is less than 10% of its original?

answer.worked:
Each bounce multiplies the height by $0.8$. After $n$ bounces, the height is $0.8^n$ of the original.
$$\begin{align*}0.8^{10}&=0.1073741824>0.1\\0.8^{11}&=0.08589934592<0.1\end{align*}$$
The height decreases at every bounce, so it first falls below 10% of the original after 11 bounces.
